{{Quote|Scanning the zone for Handro's ship's signature. Go to the expected entry point.|[[Wolff Kalos]], to Rebel pilots|<ref name="SWG:FtA" />}}
[[Cal Handro]] used a '''Warlord Heavy Cruiser''' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] Cal Handro crash-landed on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] while transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]]. He survived the crash but mysteriously vanished.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|faction=Rebel Alliance}}
After a long hunt that involved the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], Cal Handro was finally captured by Rebel agents.<ref name="SWG:WYG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Within Your Grasp"</ref> Although the smuggler was transporting spice for the Rebellion when he crashed on Rori, he was considered as a traitor by the Alliance because he used to smuggle [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for the Empire in the past.<ref name="SWG:Gc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Getting closer?"</ref> However, a group of Imperial agents rescued the smuggler from a [[Rebel Safe House]]. Handro accepted to be exfiltrated from Rori in exchange for information.<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> Imperial [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] provided a [[Warlord Heavy Cruiser]] to the smuggler who finally departed from Rori.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />

While Cal Handro was about to leave the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Rebel Officer [[Wolff Kalos]] discovered that the smuggler had escaped. A group of Rebel spacers rushed to the nearest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and launched in space to intercept the Warlord Heavy Cruiser before it jumped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. Piloting their own [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the spacers attacked the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] and its escort of Imperial starfighters. The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was heavily armored and well armed but the Rebel forces eventually destroyed it. Cal Handro died in the explosion of the ship.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cal Handro's warship appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Cal Handro's ship appeared in the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline,<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> In that chapter, the player had to choose to side with the Empire or the Rebels. Cal Handro would always join the faction opposed to the player.<ref name="SWG:FtA" /><ref name="SWG:FtE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Empire!"</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was finally removed from the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], 2006, due to the major changes planned for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
